summary: WorkBuddy (Tencent) offers free access to the Hy4 preview model for 2 weeks. Hy3 remains free through end of September. Hy4 preview is an AI model for end-to-end agent workflows including research, Office tasks, frontend development, and game development.
claim_steps: Go to workbuddy.ai and create a free account.
Access the Hy4 preview model directly in the WorkBuddy interface.

social_proof.author: WorkBuddy
social_proof.text: Hy4 preview from @TencentHunyuan is here—and it's now available on WorkBuddy. Hy4 preview is FREE to use on WorkBuddy for the next 2 weeks. And Hy3 will remain FREE through the end of September.
